events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has significant implications for global geopolitics and the economy. The conflict may lead to increased oil prices and market volatility. The US and its allies are involved in the conflict, which may lead to further escalation.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The Iran war may lead to increased oil prices, which could negatively impact the oil and gas exploration and production sector. On the other hand, the conflict may lead to increased demand for safe-haven assets, such as the S&P 500 ETF.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the conflict and adjust the position accordingly

events.exitStrategy: Close the position if the conflict de-escalates or if the oil prices drop significantly
